capabilities.description: Represent one externally generated candidate value as an unscored CreationProposal without inventing novelty, utility, feasibility or risk judgments.
Convert a CreationProposal into the existing scored Create<T> candidate shape only when an evaluator explicitly supplies all four score dimensions.

lifecycle: RNCS governed execution if separately authorized
invariants: unscored proposal carries no confidence-bearing score
all four score dimensions are explicit before scoring
candidate generator cannot self-certify its own winning score
proposal or scored candidate cannot commit RCL evidence or RNCS state by construction
claim_boundary: This contract closes an external-candidate semantic seam. It does not prove imagination quality, aesthetics, scientific truth, future success, artifact acceptance, AGI, or autonomous execution.
